given: a location has no stock records
when: the warehouse team member views that location on the home screen
then: an explicit "No stock at this location" state is shown instead of a blank page

independence.rationale: AC1 and AC2 cover the populated table (rows present, quantities aligned); AC3 covers the disjoint empty case where there are no records, asserting an explicit "No stock at this location" message rather than a blank page. The empty-state message can be absent (blank page) while populated rows render and align fine, and vice versa, so it fails independently.

architectural_notes: E2E: the empty-result branch of the same read path (client/ SPA -> boundary app/routes/ JSON -> service app/services/ -> repository app/repositories/ query of stock_records). The repository returns an empty set for a location with no records; the boundary returns an empty JSON collection (not a 404/error), and the React component maps empty -> the explicit "No stock at this location" state. Cross-cutting: empty-vs-error semantics decided in the service (empty is a valid state, not a failure); message rendering owned by the client. Verified real-branch (NFR-F1-4): with no rows seeded for a location, assert the empty-state message renders rather than a blank page.
